title: Fix deployed draft startup crash and make retry reinitialize actor/profile

requirements.text: Fix the startup failure that shows the "Something went wrong" startup screen by ensuring actor initialization cannot throw unhandled errors during app boot (including the access-control initialization call). If initialization fails, surface the actual error to the UI layer (and console) rather than leaving the app stuck in a generic startup failure state.

quotes: Le message « Something went wrong » affiché sur l’URL n-1ns-draft.caffeine.xyz

acceptanceCriteria: Loading the draft URL no longer immediately shows the startup error screen on a healthy network.
If backend/agent/actor initialization fails, the error is captured (no unhandled promise rejection) and is available to display/log for debugging.
The app does not trap solely because an admin token is missing/empty; startup works without providing any admin token.

requirements.text: Improve the StartupErrorScreen flow so the Retry action fully retries startup by re-initializing both the backend actor and the profile query (not only refetching the profile).
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Retry triggers a fresh actor initialization attempt and then re-runs the user profile fetch.
If the initial failure was transient (e.g., a temporary agent/replica error), Retry can recover without a hard refresh.
Retry does not require navigating away or clearing storage manually.

requirements.text: Change any startup/loading user-facing text that is currently in French (e.g., "Chargement...") to English.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: All loading states shown during app startup use English text (e.g., "Loading...").
No French strings remain in the startup gates (AuthGate/AuthenticatedGate) loading UI.

requirements.text: Add minimal startup diagnostics to help identify future boot failures: when the startup error screen is shown, include a compact, user-safe error summary (no secrets/tokens), and always log the full error to the browser console.
acceptanceCriteria: When startup fails, the UI shows a short error summary (e.g., "Initialization failed" + a sanitized message).
No secret values (e.g., any admin token) are rendered to the screen or logged.
The console contains enough detail (stack/message) to debug the root cause.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts directly if they are in immutable paths; if changes are needed, implement them via composition/wrappers in editable files.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add migration.mo if a stable-state schema upgrade is required.
nonGoals: Adding new product features or changing core app flows beyond fixing startup reliability and English startup copy.
Integrating third-party auth providers or external databases/services.
